missing_evidence: Payment service latency/error metrics and logs for the incident window
candidates.statement: Payment service calls from order time out (ReadTimeout, ~2s) on every checkout trace, propagating 502s at order and gateway /v1/checkout; inventory/redis calls succeed, so the latency originates at the payment dependency.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show payment ReadTimeout but no payment-side metrics/logs to confirm whether the delay is payment itself or the network path.

report.explanation: All checkout traces show order->payment POST /v1/authorizations failing with transport ReadTimeout (~2s), while inventory/redis succeed; gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 with p95 ~2.4s. This bounds the fault to the payment dependency path.
